name: tiddlywiki-journal
description: Structured daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly journaling and habit tracking for TiddlyWiki

scripts.serve: npm run ensure-debug && cross-env TIDDLYWIKI_PLUGIN_PATH=plugins tiddlywiki debug --listen port=8080
scripts.clean-serve: npm run clean-debug && npm run serve
scripts.clean-debug: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('debug', {recursive: true, force: true}); fs.cpSync('demo', 'debug', {recursive: true});"
scripts.ensure-debug: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('debug')) fs.cpSync('demo', 'debug', {recursive: true});"
scripts.build-all: npm run clean-runtime && npm run build-plugin && npm run build-demo && npm run build-library && npm run clean-runtime
scripts.build-demo: cross-env TIDDLYWIKI_PLUGIN_PATH=plugins tiddlywiki demo --output build --build index
scripts.build-library: cross-env TIDDLYWIKI_PLUGIN_PATH=plugins tiddlywiki demo --output build/library --build library

author: Matt Blackman
